verdict.rationale: Exa is an API platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, a changelog, or a deprecation policy. Downloadable OpenAPI specs (exa-docs-38) document the current API surface but are not a versioning or deprecation commitment, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
